In this video, Neuropsychologist Laura Phillips, PsyD, ABPdN, formerly of the Child Mind Institute, answers a parent's heartfelt questions: What is dyslexia? Will my child ever learn to read? How do I explain dyslexia to ease their fears? Discover expert insights on the causes, treatments, and support strategies for dyslexia, including helpful accommodations like books on tape and extended time. Learn how you can empower your child to thrive both academically and personally. 💡 Learn more about dyslexia and resources at childmind.org. 📩 Have questions or topics you’d like covered?
